questions.q: This capstone project drew on skills from how many courses total, counting this one?
options: All seven courses of the Job-Ready Foundation stage
Only this course -- the other six courses were unrelated to the project
Exactly two courses: Azure Administration and AWS Administration
Every course in the entire Cloud Engineer path, including Advanced Specialization
questions.explain: The Harrow Peak Outfitters project pulled on every course in the seven-course Job-Ready Foundation stage, not just this one.

questions.q: Why was choosing Azure for Harrow Peak Outfitters in Lesson 29 a real, defensible decision rather than a coin flip?
options: Because Azure Administration and AWS Administration taught the same underlying concepts in each provider's own vocabulary, so the choice was based on Harrow Peak's existing Entra ID investment, not unfamiliarity with AWS
Because AWS Cloud Infrastructure & Administration does not actually exist as a course in this path
Because the course required picking whichever provider was mentioned first
Because Azure is objectively the only viable provider for any deployment
questions.explain: Having learned both providers' versions of the same concepts made the choice a real, reasoned decision grounded in Harrow Peak's specific situation.

questions.q: Which earlier course's thinking shows up directly in the NSG rules from Lesson 29 and the managed identity from Lesson 30?
options: Cloud Networking, Identity & Security -- the course that taught least-privilege thinking
How IT Teams Work -- a course focused only on project management methods
PowerShell, Python, Azure CLI & Infrastructure Automation -- a scripting-only course unrelated to security
None of the other six courses relate to NSGs or managed identities
questions.explain: Least-privilege thinking, applied throughout the NSG scoping and the managed identity choice, comes directly from the identity and cloud security course.

questions.q: What two job titles does this stage of the path make a graduate ready for, according to this lesson?
options: Cloud Support Engineer and Junior Cloud Engineer
Cloud Architect and Site Reliability Engineer
Platform Engineer and Multi-Cloud Architect
Database Administrator and Network Engineer
questions.explain: The Job-Ready Foundation stage is explicitly built toward Cloud Support Engineer and Junior Cloud Engineer roles.

questions.q: What is the first course of the Advanced Specialization stage, which starts immediately after this one?
options: Terraform, Bicep & Infrastructure as Code
Docker, Kubernetes & Container Platforms
Cloud Reliability, Monitoring & FinOps
Enterprise Cloud Architecture Capstone
questions.explain: Advanced Specialization begins with Terraform, Bicep & Infrastructure as Code, shifting from operating infrastructure to declaring it before it exists.
